review_candidates.description: DATA4'S MISSION DATA4 creates Smart & Scalable digital facilities for our customers. Our network of highly connected, resilient and sustainable data center campuses underpins our customers’ digital growth in Europe. DATA4 Group finances, designs, constructs and operates its own data centers. Delivered through our data center campus model, we provide our customers with secure, scalable and high-performance data hosting solutions. DATA4 VALUES At DATA4 we are driven by our values. These are the core of everything we do – from the proactivity we show in delivering great outcomes for our clients, to the responsibility we show as a key contributor to the digital economy. Our three values are: To be entrepreneurial – we are teams of doers who make things happen - with autonomy, energy and a sense of responsibility To always take responsibility – for our impact on the people we work with, the society we are part of, and the environment in which we operate To constantly be adaptable – our business is designed to adapt, answering not only today’s challenges, but also anticipating what’s coming next. About The Role The Data Center Field Engineer – Controls and Building Management Systems (BMS) is a leadership role focused on the controls, automation and operational supervision aspects of data center infrastructure. This position involves overseeing the design, installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of controls and building management systems within the data center environment. Typically, controls and BMS comprise of controlling and automation equipment (programmable logic controllers [PLC], automation cards, sensors, operational data analysis and supervision). The Field Engineer collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, provides technical expertise, and ensures the reliability and efficiency of the controls, building management and electrical power management components supporting data center operations. The Data Center Field Engineer – Controls and BMS is responsible for conducting technical audits of data center control, monitoring, automation and actuation systems to assess their resilience, reliability, maintainability and compliance with established standards. The role performs in-depth evaluations of operational readiness, engineering practices and technical capabilities across the organization, ensuring that critical systems are effectively managed throughout their lifecycle. In addition, the Senior Field Engineer actively drives the development of engineering competencies across Data4 by delivering structured training programs, technical workshops, knowledge-sharing sessions and hands-on mentoring. Through regular technical reviews, drills, simulations and competency assessments, the role strengthens the expertise of Engineering, Operations and Technical Services teams in controls systems architecture, troubleshooting methodologies, system optimization and best operational practices. The position acts as a subject matter expert for Controls, BMS and EPMS technologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, technical excellence and standardization across all sites. By promoting consistent engineering practices, improving technical knowledge and supporting complex operational challenges, the Field Engineer ensures that teams are equipped to maintain the highest standards of safety, reliability, efficiency and resilience within mission-critical data center environments Responsibilities JOB SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES Conduct comprehensive technical audits of Controls, BMS, EPMS and critical monitoring systems across all data center sites, ensuring documentation accuracy, system resilience, maintainability and compliance with corporate standards. Maintain and update technical documentation including architecture diagrams, network topologies, control philosophies, SLD, functional analysis, EOPs, SOPs and MOPs. Establish and maintain a centralized technical knowledge base for Controls, BMS and EPMS systems, including standards, lessons learned, engineering guidelines, troubleshooting procedures, as-built documentation and commissioning records. Review, adapt and harmonize the global process of control systems operations and support local teams in streamlining energy efficiency with proper use and settings of control systems Support commissioning (Cx) and integrated systems testing (IST) for new buildings, retrofits, and capacity expansions, validate sequence of operations (SOO) against design Foster technical collaboration and engineering alignment across all countries by promoting common engineering standards, best practices, shared lessons learned and cross-site technical Develop and deliver structured technical training, workshops, competency assessments, simulations and knowledge-sharing programs to strengthen engineering expertise in controls systems, troubleshooting methodologies, system optimization and critical environment operations. Develop and implement technical reporting, performance dashboards and analytical tools that support proactive management of critical monitoring systems, operational performance, asset reliability and service continuity. Participate in technical discussions with customers, auditors, engineering partners and vendors, providing expert support for design reviews, operational assessments, resilience studies and responses to technical inquiries. Requirements Education and experience 7+ years of hands-on field engineering experience with BMS/BAS and controls systems in data centers or other mission-critical facilities Bachelor's Degree in Automation and Control Systems Engineering or equivalent experience. Proficiency in Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), including certifications from Siemens, Rockwell Automation (Allen-Bradley), or similar. Advanced expertise in at least one BMS/BAS platform and associated SCADA environment, including system architecture, database management, graphics development, alarm management, trend analysis, integration troubleshooting, redundancy validation, and operational support within mission-critical facilities. Extensive experience investigating and resolving complex automation and monitoring system failures across Controls, BMS, PLC, SCADA and EPMS platforms in critical facilities. Proven track record of leading root cause investigations, developing corrective action plans, restoring system functionality and implementing long-term reliability improvements involving hardware, software, communications infrastructure and system integrations Certifications in platforms like Honeywell BMS, Schneider Electric EcoStruxure, Siemens Desigo, or equivalent. Technical skills Required In-depth knowledge of control and building management systems, including chillers and associated cooling plant controls, electrical power management systems, electrical systems relay and programmable logic controllers, generators controllers, automatic transfer switch controls and any related components. In-depth knowledge of mission-critical construction, commissioning and operational readiness processes, with demonstrated experience validating Controls, BMS and EPMS systems through FAT, SAT, IST, integrated systems testing and final handover activities. Ability to assess system integration, control sequences, alarm strategies, redundancy performance and compliance with engineering and operational requirements. Hands-on experience in actively participating in construction projects, especially during the commissioning phase, ensuring seamless integration of controls and building management systems Demonstrated ability to review, validate and approve engineering documentation including control philosophies, functional descriptions, cause-and-effect matrices, points lists, network architectures, single-line diagrams (SLD), sequence of operations, as-built documentation and commissioning records prior to operational handover Hands-on experience leading controls and BMS commissioning activities, including verification of control sequences, network communications, alarm functionality, trend collection, redundancy testing, failover validation and system integration with mechanical and electrical infrastructure Preferred Experience in people management Ability to participate in technical discussions with customers and contribute to addressing their technical requests. Skills in liaising with other Data4 teams and vendors to retrieve technical details and studies requested by customers during audits. Capability to develop a technical constructive synergy between different countries, fostering collaboration and knowledge exchange Experience in increasing operational teams' involvement through training initiatives, knowledge-sharing, and skill development programs Language proficiency Fluent English (B2/C1) Additional language at B1 level minimum a plus (French, Spanish, Polish, Italian, German) Soft skills Excellent communication skills to convey complex technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Strong collaboration skills to work closely with cross-functional teams Analytical mindset and strong problem-solving skills to diagnose and resolve complex issues Ability to address engineering and design challenges during deep dives Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities, technologies, and project requirements Effective project management skills to oversee and actively participate in construction projects, ensuring timely and successful completion Skills in developing and implementing training programs to increase the technical knowledge and skills of operational teams

review_candidates.description: Job Description 楽天・事業について 楽天は日本最大のマーケットプレイスであり、eコマース、旅行、銀行、フィンテック、フードデリバリー、ゴルフ、保険、インスタントメッセージング、モバイルネットワークなど、70以上の幅広いサービスを提供するインターネットエコシステムです。楽天は世界で140以上のサービスを展開していますが、その中でもコミュニケーションズ & エナジーカンパニーは、携帯電話事業をはじめとする情報通信・海外通信事業者への通信プラットフォーム提供事業と電力エネルギー関連事業を展開している事業部となります。 ※コミュニケーションズ & エナジーカンパニーのサービスは下記よりご確認ください※ https://corp.rakuten.co.jp/about/company/communications_energy.html Information Officer）オフィスでは、C&Eカンパニーに所属する楽天モバイル・楽天シンフォニー・楽天コミュニケーションズのIT環境を最適化し事業効率化を促進するため、全社的なIT戦略のフレームワ―クの構築・戦略策定・企画・プロジェクトリードを担うメンバーを募集しています。 このポジションは、中長期戦略を描きながら、IT環境のプロセスと仕組みの最適化を図りつつ、様々なプロジェクトや施策推進を担当頂きます。 業務内容 ・業務概要 楽天グループのIT戦略の中核を担うCIOオフィスの一員として、楽天モバイルをはじめとするC&Eカンパニー全体のITガバナンス強化（リスク抑制）、IT投資（コスト構造）の最適化、およびデータドリブンな意思決定基盤の構築に向けた実務リード。CIO直下でCxO層と連携し、経営戦略と技術戦略を同期させるためのアライメント確立および組織への浸透のためのガバナンスの強化に関わる施策推進を担う。 ・業務詳細 IT情報基盤の高度化: 全社的なITインフラの標準化と、モダンな開発・運用環境への移行を推進。 ポートフォリオマネジメント: 数百億円規模のIT投資予算に対し、ROIを最大化するための優先順位付けと進捗管理。 ITコストの可視化と適正化: クラウド利用料（AWS/GCP等）やライセンス費の透明化を行い、FinOpsの観点からコスト効率を改善。 リソースマネジメント: 数千人規模のエンジニアリソースの最適配置と、スキルセットの可視化・育成計画の策定。 データドリブンな業務体制: BIツールを活用した経営ダッシュボードの構築および、各部門の意思決定プロセスの定量化。 組織統括: CIOオフィスとしての戦略策定、KPI管理、および次世代リーダー育成のための施策実行。 ・やりがい・魅力 インパクト: 楽天モバイルという大規模かつ挑戦的な事業において、技術と経営が交差する最前線でインパクトを出せる。 視座の高さ: CIOの右腕として、CxOクラスの経営判断のプロセスに深く関与し、全社視点での意思決定力を養える。 成長環境: 変化の激しいグローバル組織において、技術力とマネジメントスキルの両面で市場価値を最大化できる。 ・ステークホルダー 内部: CIO、各事業部門のCTO/VPoE、財務部門、人事部門、各プロダクト開発チーム。 外部: グローバルITベンダー、コンサルティングファーム、外部監査法人等。 ・業務の進め方 アジャイルな意思決定: 定期的なステアリングコミッティの運営と、Slack/Jira等を用いたリアルタイムな進捗管理。 クロスファンクショナル: ・大規模組織でのプロジェクト経験 ・マネジメント経験 その他： 勤務地に関する補足 楽天クリムゾンハウス #ビジネス職 #business #コミュニケーションズアンドエナジーカンパニー #communicationsandenergy #ディレクター #プロジェクトマネージャー #director #projectmanager Languages English (総合 - 3 - 上級), review_candidates.description: Eaton’s ES AMER ARS division is currently seeking a Supply Chain Systems Analyst (ERP). The position will be based at our facility in El Paso, Texas. The expected annual salary range for this role is $71000 - $105000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program. Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. The ERP Key User serves as the primary functional expert and business representative for the ERP system within the Supply Chain organization. This role is responsible for ensuring the integrity, effectiveness, and continuous improvement of ERP processes that support planning, procurement, inventory management, production, logistics and customer fulfillment. Acting as the bridge between business users and IT, the ERP Key User drives system adoption, supports ERP enhancements, leads user training, resolves functional issues and ensures standardized processes across the organization. The role plays a critical part in digital transformation initiatives by improving data accuracy, operational efficiency, and end-to-end process performance. Primary Responsibilities Serve as the primary functional expert for ERP-related processes within Supply Chain and Operations. Support daily ERP activities by troubleshooting functional issues and coordinating resolution with IT or external system support teams. Ensure ERP master data accuracy, including items, BOMs, routings, suppliers, customers, inventory parameters, planning settings, and other operational data. Lead testing, validation, and deployment of ERP system enhancements, upgrades, patches, and new functionalities. Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for ERP transactions and business processes. Train new employees and provide ongoing coaching to ERP users to ensure consistent and effective system utilization. Identify process improvement opportunities and recommend ERP-based solutions that increase productivity, data visibility, and process standardization. Support cross-functional projects involving Operations, Planning, Procurement, Customer Service, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, and IT. Monitor ERP transactional compliance and promote adherence to standard business processes. What You’ll Do Analyze ERP data to identify process gaps, system errors, and opportunities for operational improvements. Support inventory accuracy initiatives by ensuring proper system transactions and master data governance. Participate in ERP implementations, new module deployments, and digital transformation initiatives. Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and document business requirements for system enhancements. Collaborate with Business Process Analysts to automate reports, dashboards, and workflow improvements. Ensure planning parameters, lead times, scheduling policies, and inventory settings are properly maintained to support MRP accuracy. Assist in root cause analysis of transactional issues affecting production, material planning, customer deliveries, or inventory performance. Maintain strong communication between business users and IT to prioritize ERP support requests and enhancement projects. Promote continuous improvement using Lean principles, process standardization, and best practices. Support KPI reporting related to ERP adoption, transaction accuracy, inventory integrity, planning performance, and operational efficiency. On-board IG team members to handle C: drive issues for end users in their local offices. Work individually with end users to organize email folders and link to a workspace, as appropriate. Create and promote a program of IG best practices, tying together iManage Work and network drive compliance requirements and acceptable use for storing and sharing firm data. Support the Office Managing Partner with Information Governance related needs for the office. Provide iManage Work training to new joiners in the international regional offices. Collaborate with the IT Training team to align on content and training materials. Mentor team members by expanding their skillset in Information Governance operations tasks and workflows. E xceptional attention to detail, strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent customer service orientation, positive, proactive manner. Ability to organize, plan and carry out multiple projects simultaneously. Must be both a self-starter and a team player. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision required. In addition, this role is eligible for a discretionary bonus based on performance. The actual offered rate for this position will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors, including qualifications and experience, geographic location, education, external market data and consideration of internal equity. Working Conditions Standard office schedule is onsite five days per week. Work schedule is 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM in Hong Kong and 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM in Tokyo but must be available evenings and weekends as required. Travel, as required.
